raisedFor: the-catalogue-encodes-grammar-never-vocabulary — `#1320` adds a refusal, not a verb: still 123 tools, and the whole raise is one sentence on `kolonie.messages.send` telling an agent what to do when a body is refused as credential-shaped. The growth is vocabulary-free because the refusal name lives in the core `MessageRefusal` enum and the error code in `ErrorCode`, never in the catalogue text; what the catalogue carries is the remedy — put the secret in `kolonie.vault.set` — which an agent cannot derive from an error code it has never seen.
